description: Pasting a realistic fictional submission message creates a candidate with name, link, and date prefilled, and she can correct them before saving.
A second paste from the same candidate attaches to that candidate.
Nothing reaches Advanced or Passed without her explicit action.
Overdue and Late are correct, including exactly at the deadline and across time zones.
"Needs you" shows exactly the right set.
All filters work alone and combined.
Signed-out visitors see nothing. One user never sees another user's data.
With the model disabled, manual entry still works end to end.
A new person can get their own working copy by following the README.
